complaint.transcript: The vehicle lost power again after several repair attempts. The issue remains unresolved and affects normal use. I request a vehicle return under the Three Guarantees policy.
complaint.scanSummary: Written complaint records repeated power loss, three repair visits and a formal vehicle-return request.

objective: Determine Three Guarantees scope and return conditions, then assess the customer remedy and internal BMW/dealer allocation separately.

agents.name: Customer Care
agents.task: Plan the review, coordinate work and consolidate the applicability and compensation recommendation

agents.name: Warranty Agent
findings: Repair count alone does not meet the more-than-four condition

agents.name: Technical Service Agent
agents.task: Retrieve the TSARA Result and establish fault origin
findings: Fault persists after repeated repair attempts

recommendation.title: Likely Eligible for Return · Human Decision Required
reasons: TSARA confirms an unresolved serious safety-performance fault
Three visits are not used as the standalone threshold
Internal BMW/dealer allocation is assessed separately from customer entitlement
